---
description: Use the South Quay/Western Tolerance Hall precedent to assess cascade risk before authorizing a new correction near a confirmed Bloomrot source.
agent: mote
---

Before authorizing any new correction against `rel-south-quay-walkout` or any
relationship linked to the `anomaly-western-tolerance-hall` Bloomrot-confirmed
case, review the precedent: the original South Quay correction created the
displaced consequence that later manifested at Western Tolerance Hall.

Check whether `WARN_BLOOMROT_CASCADE` would fire for the proposed correction.
If it does, do not let the Choir proceed without also securing House Vey's
explicit sign-off — report the cascade risk plainly rather than letting it
pass as a routine authorization.
